lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five horizontal tiers posterior to the gills. The clusters exhibit irregular spacing along the longitudinal axis with higher density observed in the dorsal-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot tiers to form a non-orthogonal grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple longitudinal linear features are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a distinct luminance gradient with high-intensity highlights on the superior edge and low-intensity shadows on the inferior edge.
